name: Chiaroscuro woodcut
summary: A line block carries the drawing and one to three tone blocks are printed over it in flat washes of one hue. The flat steps from paper white to dark ground imitate a brush-and-wash drawing heightened with white.

philosophy.core_thesis: Flat tone blocks printed in steps over a line block imitate a brush-and-wash drawing heightened with white, with no hatching.
design_principles: Cut a key block for the contour and the deepest shadow, and print it in black or dark brown.
Cut one to three tone blocks, and print each as a flat wash of one hue at 20–60 % of the key density.
Cut the highlights out of each tone block, so that the bare paper shows as white.
Keep each tone edge hard; step from one wash to the next and do not blend.
Print all tone blocks in one hue family, so that the picture reads as one drawing.
Allow 0.5–1.5 mm of key-block offset against the tone blocks.
anti_patterns: A smooth gradient or a soft wash edge
Halftone dots or a photographic tone
White highlights added with opaque white ink
Hatching that fills the tone areas

process.matrix: Plank woodblocks (pear, cherry), one key block and one to three tone blocks
process.press: Hand press, rubbed or screw press
process.image_making: Key block cut with knife in line; tone blocks gouged so that highlights are cut away and paper shows through
process.edition: Dozens to low hundreds; blocks recut or re-inked in later states

inks.strategy: A dark key ink and one to three transparent tints of one hue, each printed from its own block.

screening.rule: Make each tone as a flat wash from one block; stack two or three blocks to get four to five tone steps, with no screen.

registration.rule: Each block is printed by hand against pin or register marks; the key block can sit 0.5–1.5 mm off the tone blocks.

substrate.stock: Hand-made laid paper, cream to ivory, with chain lines.
substrate.finish: Laid, lightly sized, with a soft tooth that takes a thin wash of ink.

surface.impression: A light bite from the hand press; the blocks show as a faint relief on the back.
surface.sheen: Matt, with a slight shine where the ink is thick.
surface.texture: Flat washes with hard edges, and the grain of the wood in the larger tone areas.

marks: flat tone steps with hard edges

evidence.title: St John the Baptist Preaching in the Desert (after Raphael)
evidence.credit: Museum of Fine Arts Budapest, via Wikimedia Commons

evidence.title: Diogenes, chiaroscuro woodcut
evidence.credit: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access, via Wikimedia Commons

emotion.target_response: Calm, learned warmth: the viewer sees a wash drawing of a classical scene, in a few quiet steps of one colour.

use_cases: wine and spirits labels with a heritage look
avoid_when: The image needs a full range of colours.
The design needs exact register of fine text.

modifiers.how: Drop the tone blocks, keep the key block and hatch the shadows with black lines.
Replace the stepped tones with a smooth rocked-plate tone in one dark ink.
